Fifteen preschoolers in your living room? You have options.

We rounded up 10 birthday party spots in and around Spring Branch and Memorial: a toddler studio in the Heights, an indoor playground, a gym for 1-year-olds, ninja and tumbling, an indoor pool, a nature playscape, pottery painting, and a covered park pad by a Memorial Park playground that starts around $70.

Our biggest tip: book 4 to 6 weeks ahead, because weekend slots go first. And always ask what's included before you pay.
